points.K15: 健康物理要回答的问题

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个发光细胞模型和一支带屏蔽套的注射器图标之间，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a large glowing cell model and a big icon of a syringe inside a shielded sleeve, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：辐射为什么伤人，又怎样治病。
overlay: 辐射为什么伤人，又怎样治病

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 左边破裂细胞图标，右边带绿勾的靶心图标
shots.prompt_en: A cracked cell icon on the left and a target icon with a green check mark on the right, joined by an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 先看伤害从哪来，再看怎样用好它。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 核医学实验室里，阿杰看着托盘上一个小铅罐，伸手要去拿
shots.prompt_en: In a nuclear medicine lab, the young male student looks at a small lead container on a tray lined with absorbent paper and reaches out with a bare hand.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次到核医学实验室帮忙。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰指着天花板上的灯，耸耸肩
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points up at the ceiling lights and shrugs casually.
shots.narration: 他想：灯光天天照我，也没事呀。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研戴着手套和剂量计走来，伸手拦住他
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves and a dosimeter badge, walks over and raises a hand to stop him.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：这可不是普通的光。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a question mark floating above him.
shots.narration: 阿杰糊涂了：都是能量，差在哪？

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白黑板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank chalkboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们从健康物理讲起。

shots.section_title: 健康物理：辐射有害也有益
shots.scene: 一颗心形图标和一个原子图标用加号连在一起
shots.prompt_en: A heart icon and an atom icon joined by a plus sign. No people.
shots.narration: 健康物理，研究辐射怎样影响健康。
overlay: 健康物理：辐射有害也有益

shots.section_title: 健康物理：辐射有害也有益
shots.scene: 天平一端是破裂细胞图标，另一端是医院图标
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a cracked cell icon on one pan and a hospital icon on the other pan. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射不全是坏事，用好了能治病。

shots.section_title: 健康物理：辐射有害也有益
shots.scene: 阿杰和小研在空白黑板前听讲
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student sit at desks facing a blank chalkboard, listening attentively.
shots.narration: 所以既要会防护，也要会利用。

shots.section_title: 剂量学：先懂剂量，再学测量
shots.scene: 一碗米饭放在厨房秤上，旁边是一堆数不清的小块
shots.prompt_en: A bowl of rice sits on a kitchen scale with a blank display, next to a messy pile of small food pieces. No people.
shots.narration: 说吃了六块不准，要说吃了500克。
overlay: 剂量学：先懂剂量，再学测量

shots.section_title: 剂量学：先懂剂量，再学测量
shots.scene: 一束射线照向一个人形图标，人形旁是一个问号刻度表
shots.prompt_en: A beam of small arrows shines on a human outline icon, beside a blank gauge dial with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 受了多少辐射，也要有个量度。

shots.section_title: 剂量学：先懂剂量，再学测量
shots.scene: 两个台阶图标：先是放大镜，再是仪表
shots.prompt_en: Two step icons: the first step holds a magnifying glass, the second step holds a meter with a blank dial. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量学：先弄清剂量是什么。

shots.section_title: 剂量学：先懂剂量，再学测量
shots.scene: 小研拿着一个空白表盘的仪器演示
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a handheld meter with a blank dial and shows it to the young male student.
shots.narration: 再学怎样用仪器把它测出来。

shots.section_title: 应用核物理：物理加生物
shots.scene: 一棵树的树干是原子图标，分出三根树枝
shots.prompt_en: A tree whose trunk is an atom icon, splitting into three branches ending in a particle ring icon, a power plant icon and a hospital icon. No people.
shots.narration: 核物理有很多应用。
overlay: 应用核物理：物理加生物

shots.section_title: 应用核物理：物理加生物
shots.scene: 加速器环形图标和反应堆图标各打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A ring-shaped particle accelerator icon and a reactor building icon, each with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 加速器、反应堆，都是核物理的应用。

shots.section_title: 应用核物理：物理加生物
shots.scene: 原子图标和细胞图标握手
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon atom icon and a cartoon cell icon shake hands. No people.
shots.narration: 健康物理，让物理和生物握手。

shots.section_title: 应用核物理：物理加生物
shots.scene: 一排空白的尺子、秤和表盘图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of measuring icons: a ruler, a scale and a gauge dial, all blank. No people.
shots.narration: 第一步，先学各种测量量和单位。

shots.section_title: 灯光照人为什么不伤人
shots.scene: 天花板灯光照在阿杰身上，光线从他身上反射到小研眼里
shots.prompt_en: Light from ceiling lamps falls on the young male student and bounces off him toward the eyes of the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 你看得见我，是因为灯光照到我身上。
overlay: 灯光照人为什么不伤人

shots.section_title: 灯光照人为什么不伤人
shots.scene: 光线一部分被皮肤吸收，一部分四散反射
shots.prompt_en: Close-up diagram of skin: some light rays sink into the surface, others scatter back in many directions. No people.
shots.narration: 一部分光被吸收，其余散射进你眼里。

shots.section_title: 灯光照人为什么不伤人
shots.scene: 放大镜下皮肤细胞里的小分子轻轻摇晃
shots.prompt_en: Under a magnifying glass, tiny ball-and-stick molecules inside a skin cell jiggle gently. No people.
shots.narration: 被吸收的可见光，只让分子晃一晃。

shots.section_title: 灯光照人为什么不伤人
shots.scene: 一只手轻拍手臂，旁边一个绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A hand gently pats a forearm, with a green check mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 就像轻拍皮肤，细胞完全承受得住。

shots.section_title: 灯光照人为什么不伤人
shots.scene: 小光点撞到原子，电子纹丝不动
shots.prompt_en: A small soft light dot bumps into an atom, and the electron on its orbit stays in place. No people.
shots.narration: 它能量太小，打不出电子。

shots.section_title: 断一个键，细胞就出问题
shots.scene: 细胞剖面里塞满许多球棍分子
shots.prompt_en: A cell cross-section packed with many ball-and-stick molecules. No people.
shots.narration: 细胞由大量分子组成。
overlay: 断一个键，细胞就出问题

shots.section_title: 断一个键，细胞就出问题
shots.scene: 一条长长的原子链，原子之间用小棍相连
shots.prompt_en: A long chain of atoms connected by small sticks, like a beaded necklace. No people.
shots.narration: 分子是原子用化学键连起来的链。

shots.section_title: 断一个键，细胞就出问题
shots.scene: 长链上一根小棍啪地断开
shots.prompt_en: One small stick in the long atom chain snaps apart with a tiny spark. No people.
shots.narration: 一个大分子，哪怕只断一个键……

shots.section_title: 断一个键，细胞就出问题
shots.scene: 细胞里的齿轮卡住冒烟
shots.prompt_en: Inside a cartoon cell, a set of small gears jams and gives off a puff of smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 细胞的运转就会受影响。

shots.section_title: 断一个键，细胞就出问题
shots.scene: 细胞图标边缘出现裂纹
shots.prompt_en: A round cell icon with cracks appearing along its edge. No people.
shots.narration: 这就是细胞损伤的开始。

shots.section_title: 化学看断键，物理看电离
shots.scene: 左边断开的小棍，右边飞出的电子，中间等号
shots.prompt_en: On the left a snapped stick between two atoms, on the right an electron flying off an atom, with an equals sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 同一件事，有两种说法。
overlay: 化学看断键，物理看电离

shots.section_title: 化学看断键，物理看电离
shots.scene: 化学烧瓶图标指向断开的小棍
shots.prompt_en: A chemistry flask icon pointing to a snapped stick between two atoms. No people.
shots.narration: 化学上，叫断键。

shots.section_title: 化学看断键，物理看电离
shots.scene: 原子图标的一个电子被弹出轨道飞走
shots.prompt_en: An atom icon with one electron knocked off its orbit and flying away. No people.
shots.narration: 物理上，叫电离：电子被打出去。

shots.section_title: 化学看断键，物理看电离
shots.scene: 失去电子的原子松开了旁边的小棍
shots.prompt_en: The atom that lost its electron loosens its grip on the stick connecting it to its neighbor. No people.
shots.narration: 少了电子，化学键也跟着变了。

shots.section_title: α、β、γ都能断键电离
shots.scene: α、β、γ三个射线图标飞向原子链
shots.prompt_en: Three ray icons, a heavy ball, a small fast dot and a wavy line, fly toward an atom chain. No people.
shots.narration: α、β、γ这些电离辐射，

shots.section_title: α、β、γ都能断键电离
shots.scene: 原子链多处断开，电子四散
shots.prompt_en: The atom chain breaks at several points and electrons scatter away. No people.
shots.narration: 都能打出电子、打断化学键。

shots.section_title: α、β、γ都能断键电离
shots.scene: 欣欣指着断开的链
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a broken atom chain model on a table.
shots.narration: 所以要研究辐射对细胞的影响。

shots.section_title: 细胞里的分子五花八门
shots.scene: 一个细胞剖面：外层膜、中间细胞核、周围小细胞器
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway cartoon of a human cell: an outer membrane, a nucleus in the middle and small organelles floating around. No people.
shots.narration: 细胞有壁有膜，有核、细胞质和细胞器。
overlay: 细胞里的分子五花八门

shots.section_title: 细胞里的分子五花八门
shots.scene: 细胞剖面外圈一层硬壁亮起
shots.prompt_en: The outer rigid wall layer of the cutaway cell glows. No people.
shots.narration: 最外层是细胞壁。

shots.section_title: 细胞里的分子五花八门
shots.scene: 细胞里漂着形状、颜色各不相同的分子
shots.prompt_en: Inside a cell, molecules of many different shapes and colors float around. No people.
shots.narration: 细胞里的分子，有很多种。

shots.section_title: 思想实验：γ源照细胞
shots.scene: 一个带电离辐射警告标志的小铅罐放在细胞培养皿旁
shots.prompt_en: A small lead container with an ionizing radiation warning sign sits next to a petri dish of cells on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 做个思想实验：把γ源放到细胞旁。

shots.section_title: 思想实验：γ源照细胞
shots.scene: 波浪线射线穿过培养皿
shots.prompt_en: Wavy lines pass from the container through the petri dish. No people.
shots.narration: γ射线穿过细胞样品。

shots.section_title: 思想实验：γ源照细胞
shots.scene: 老周和小研隔着屏蔽观察，手拿空白记录本
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student watch from behind a transparent shield, holding a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 会发生什么？这正是健康物理的问题。

shots.section_title: 思想实验：γ源照细胞
shots.scene: 小铅罐旁一个能量刻度卡
shots.prompt_en: A small lead container next to an energy scale card with one mark highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 用铯137源，发射662千电子伏γ射线。

shots.section_title: 哪种辐射对哪个器官更有害
shots.scene: 一个四乘四方格，每格一种不同形状的分子
shots.prompt_en: A four-by-four grid, each cell holding a differently shaped molecule icon. No people.
shots.narration: 把细胞想成由十六种分子组成。
overlay: 哪种辐射对哪个器官更有害

shots.section_title: 哪种辐射对哪个器官更有害
shots.scene: 方格中两格闪光
shots.prompt_en: Two squares in the grid glow brightly while the rest stay dim. No people.
shots.narration: 比如8号、10号分子，吸收得更多。

shots.section_title: 哪种辐射对哪个器官更有害
shots.scene: 人体轮廓里几个器官亮度不同
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with several organs glowing at different brightness levels. No people.
shots.narration: 人体也一样，器官受影响各不相同。

shots.section_title: 哪种辐射对哪个器官更有害
shots.scene: 同样光照下的两个器官图标，一个亮得多
shots.prompt_en: Two organ icons under the same beam of light, one glowing much brighter as it soaks up more rays. No people.
shots.narration: 有的部位对某种射线、某种能量吸收更多。

shots.section_title: 哪种辐射对哪个器官更有害
shots.scene: 小研对照一张空白图表，把射线图标和器官图标连线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student draws lines on a blank chart connecting ray icons to organ icons.
shots.narration: 弄清哪种辐射伤哪个器官。

shots.section_title: 哪种辐射对哪个器官更有害
shots.scene: 一件防护衣和一个药瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A protective suit icon and a medicine bottle icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 再据此设计防护衣或药物保护自己。

shots.section_title: 局部断键，可累及全身
shots.scene: 一条小蛇图标旁，毒液小滴进入血管
shots.prompt_en: A small cartoon snake icon beside a blood vessel drawing, a tiny drop of venom entering it. No people.
shots.narration: 断键是化学变化，就像被毒蛇咬了。

shots.section_title: 局部断键，可累及全身
shots.scene: 毒液小点沿血管流向各个器官
shots.prompt_en: Tiny venom dots flow along the blood vessels to different organ icons. No people.
shots.narration: 毒液断开分子的键，随血流进各器官。

shots.section_title: 局部断键，可累及全身
shots.scene: 细胞图标、组织图标、器官图标依次变暗
shots.prompt_en: A cell icon, a tissue icon and an organ icon dim one after another along an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 细胞坏了，组织和器官跟着受损。

shots.section_title: 局部断键，可累及全身
shots.scene: 人体轮廓多个器官同时亮红灯
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with red warning lights on several organs at once. No people.
shots.narration: 大剂量照射，可能伤及全身多个器官。

shots.section_title: 局部断键，可累及全身
shots.scene: 多个器官图标依次变灰
shots.prompt_en: Several organ icons turn grey one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 最后多器官衰竭，受大剂量辐射也一样。

shots.section_title: 局部断键，可累及全身
shots.scene: 欣欣表情认真
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks serious and nods slowly.
shots.narration: 所以，辐射剂量必须认真对待。

shots.section_title: 辐射治病：只打坏细胞
shots.scene: 一群笑脸好细胞中夹着几个皱眉坏细胞
shots.prompt_en: A crowd of smiling healthy cell icons with a few frowning dark tumor cell icons among them. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射也能治病，比如对付癌细胞。

shots.section_title: 辐射治病：只打坏细胞
shots.scene: 射线击中坏细胞，坏细胞裂开
shots.prompt_en: A narrow beam hits a dark tumor cell and the tumor cell cracks apart. No people.
shots.narration: 打断癌细胞的化学键，让它死亡。

shots.section_title: 辐射治病：只打坏细胞
shots.scene: 坏细胞紧挨着好细胞
shots.prompt_en: Dark tumor cells pressed tightly against smiling healthy cells. No people.
shots.narration: 可癌细胞和健康细胞挨在一起。

shots.section_title: 辐射治病：只打坏细胞
shots.scene: 靶心图标对准坏细胞，好细胞上有盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A target reticle centered on the tumor cells while the healthy cells around them are covered by small shields. No people.
shots.narration: 治疗要只打坏细胞，少伤好细胞。

shots.section_title: 两种办法：止增殖或杀死
shots.scene: 一个细胞分成两个，两个分成四个，四个分成八个
shots.prompt_en: One cell splits into two, two into four, four into eight, in a growing tree diagram. No people.
shots.narration: 癌细胞会不断分裂，越长越多。
overlay: 两种办法：止增殖或杀死

shots.section_title: 两种办法：止增殖或杀死
shots.scene: 分裂箭头被红色停止标记拦住
shots.prompt_en: The splitting arrows of the cell tree are blocked by a red stop marker. No people.
shots.narration: 办法一：让它停止分裂，肿瘤不再长。

shots.section_title: 两种办法：止增殖或杀死
shots.scene: 坏细胞化成小光点消失
shots.prompt_en: A dark tumor cell dissolves into small sparkles and disappears. No people.
shots.narration: 办法二：直接把它杀死。

shots.section_title: 按病选射线种类
shots.scene: α、β射线图标排在药瓶图标旁
shots.prompt_en: A heavy ball ray icon and a small fast dot ray icon placed next to a blank medicine vial icon. No people.
shots.narration: 治疗会用不同种类的射线。

shots.section_title: 按病选射线种类
shots.scene: 坏细胞张嘴吃下α小球，露出满足的样子
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon tumor cell opens its mouth and gobbles up small alpha particle balls. No people.
shots.narration: 某类病变细胞，很爱吃3兆电子伏的α。

shots.section_title: 按病选射线种类
shots.scene: 同样的β小球在坏细胞旁弹开
shots.prompt_en: Small beta particle balls of the same size bounce off the tumor cell. No people.
shots.narration: 换成同能量的β，就没那么有效。

shots.section_title: 按病选射线种类
shots.scene: 射线图标和能量刻度对准病变细胞
shots.prompt_en: A ray icon and an energy dial aimed at a diseased cell icon. No people.
shots.narration: 要按病变细胞，选射线种类和能量。

shots.section_title: 健康物理要回答的问题
shots.scene: 一张清单图标，前几项打勾
shots.prompt_en: A clipboard icon with a blank checklist; the first few lines get check marks one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 健康物理要回答一串问题。
overlay: 健康物理要回答的问题

shots.section_title: 健康物理要回答的问题
shots.scene: 器官图标和射线图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Organ icons and ray icons lined up side by side with question marks between them. No people.
shots.narration: 哪个器官？哪种辐射？

shots.section_title: 健康物理要回答的问题
shots.scene: 一个空白刻度的量杯和一个效果图标
shots.prompt_en: A measuring cup with blank markings next to a cell effect icon. No people.
shots.narration: 受多少剂量，会出现什么效应？

shots.section_title: 健康物理要回答的问题
shots.scene: DNA双螺旋上出现缺口
shots.prompt_en: A DNA double helix with a small notch broken out of it. No people.
shots.narration: 还有分子破坏带来的DNA变化。

shots.section_title: 健康物理要回答的问题
shots.scene: 欣欣在空白黑板前合上书本
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot closes a book in front of a blank blackboard and smiles.
shots.narration: 这些，就是健康物理要研究的。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现细胞和断开的链
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a floating cell icon and a snapped atom chain icon.
shots.narration: 辐射伤人，是因为断键和电离。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 灯泡打勾，射线图标打警示
shots.prompt_en: A light bulb icon with a green check mark next to a ray icon with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 可见光能量小，电离辐射才伤细胞。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 器官图标亮度不同
shots.prompt_en: Several organ icons glowing at different brightness levels. No people.
shots.narration: 不同器官，吸收的辐射不一样。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 钥匙配锁和靶心图标
shots.prompt_en: A key-and-lock icon next to a target reticle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 治病要打准坏细胞，少伤好细胞。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 停止分裂标记和消失的坏细胞
shots.prompt_en: A stop sign over a dividing cell and a tumor cell fading away. No people.
shots.narration: 止住增殖或直接杀死，选对射线和能量。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣在核医学科门口挥手道别，身旁发光细胞模型
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera at the entrance of a nuclear medicine department, beside a glowing cell model.
shots.narration: 懂原理，才能用好辐射！
